_doc: D4 — provider x capability x helm-level support matrix (SP-20260718-001 Phase 0). Companion to top-level-runtime-contract.md §4. Consumed by conformance-matrix.js (gate 'support-matrix') and, from Phase-3 exit, becomes the BINDING G0.3 gate (ED-214).
_encoding_note: Each row's capabilities map gives, per capability, the set of packet-16 helm-levels (0-3) at which that capability is PROVEN supported today, plus an evidence_ref. Level 3 (WarpOS Master Console, packet-16: 'long-term target') is NOT built for ANY helm yet — no row's supported_levels includes 3. That is a Phase-2+ deliverable (RATIFIED-PLAN Phase 2: per-helm trusted bindings), not a Phase-0 fabrication. This is the Phase-0 SEED granularity; Phase-1 F3 refines with the prompt-shape dimension (RATIFIED-PLAN Phase 1).

helm_levels.1: file-aware (reads repo, produces patches; no command execution)
helm_levels.3: WarpOS Master Console (provider-neutral top-level UI/API; long-term target, not yet built for any helm)

durable_rule: A lane resolved DOWN is reflected in EVERY artifact that assumed it UP. conformance-matrix.js reads the 'status' field directly (not a cached/echoed liveness claim) so a false-green agy seed cannot propagate into the Phase-1 G1.5 panel lane contract — a config-intent echo is NOT liveness (the exact trap that fooled the 2026-07-16 attestation).
